description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for handling customer reward reports within the OpenCart admin extension. It manages rendering the report page, saving report settings, and generating customer reward data with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: CustomerReward
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer reward report page, settings, and report data in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes report page, loads language, sets breadcrumbs, loads view templates, and renders the customer reward report form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report settings, checks permissions, updates settings, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer reward report view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer reward report list for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and prepares customer reward data with filtering and pagination for display.
